subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Curious About Your Teaching Years
body:
Hi Robynne,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid. Building Kingsborough's culinary program and then leaving the tenure track in your forties to open a 1,700 square foot corner room in Chinatown is trading a safe classroom for the hardest one there is.

I'm building an AI teaching assistant, so I'm hungry to learn and would love to know what you think you would be teaching now if Fête had never opened. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
